blocks.text: SIBAGAT, Agusan del Sur — Local officials here are banking on regenerative farming, youth engagement, and incoming agricultural investments to cement this upland municipality’s role as a premier organic hub. The town also aims to help establish Agusan del Sur as the food basket of the Caraga Region. Vice Mayor Maria Liza Evangelista underscored that sustainable agriculture remains the province’s strongest defense against poverty, food insecurity, and rising commodity prices. She made this known as she spoke at the 5th Sibagat Organic Agriculture Congress on Wednesday here. The local executive was addressing farmers, agricultural technicians and local officials.
